_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Tube Investments of India (TII), consolidated, Rs crore. History is attributable to TII shareholders (Screener Net Profit replaced by Profit for EPS, see tools/authoring/TIINDIA.patch.js). The consolidated P&L is built from four blocks that sum to reported revenue and EBITDA: TII standalone, CG Power (100%), Shanthi Gears (100%) and a residual that is mostly TI Clean Mobility's EV start-up losses (with TI Medical, 3xper, Kcaltech, Sedis and eliminations). The tax line also carries minority interests (43.71% of CG Power, 29.54% of Shanthi Gears). The stock is valued as the street values it: a sum of the parts of the standalone business on P/E, the listed stakes at their 30-Sep-2026 closes less a holding-company discount, and the unlisted subsidiaries at cost. The standalone value and the discount are derived in tools/authoring/TIINDIA.val.js, which writes them into the parts below.

segments.name: TII standalone
segments._why: Engineering (precision tubes, CRSS; 65% of segment revenue), metal formed products (chains, door frames; 19%), cycles (9%) and others (industrial chains, new businesses; 11%). FY26 +8.4%; Q1FY27 +17.9% (engineering volume +17%, MFP +11.5%, cycles +26%) before steel-price pass-through, which comes with a 2-3 quarter lag. FY27E +13% (strong Q1, then a higher base and price pass-through), FY28-29E +10% (engineering volumes ~7-8% plus new capacity in the west; MFP greenfield running 6 months late).
segments._marginWhy: EBITDA = PBDIT less other income (AR). 12.2% FY23, 12.1% FY24, 12.2% FY25, 12.7% FY26; Q1FY27 ~10.4% (MOSL) as steel costs rose ahead of price resets. Management expects full recovery, including Q1's shortfall. FY27E 11.5% (recovery from Q2), FY28E 12.3%, FY29E 12.5% (cycles margin +2 points; no further engineering expansion assumed).

segments.name: CG Power (100%)
segments._why: Motors, drives, railway equipment (industrial systems), transformers and switchgear (power systems), and the new semiconductor businesses (CG Semi OSAT, Axiro). Revenue +25% in FY26, +14% in Q1FY27 (power systems +31%). New EHV switchgear plant from Jun-2026; CG Semi's G1 OSAT plant in production from Jul-2026. 15% / 16% / 15%. Consolidated for the P&L only: in the valuation TII's 56.29% is at market. CG Power is covered separately; we take no view on its own valuation here.
segments._marginWhy: Screener EBITDA margin 13.2% FY26, 12.1% Q1FY27 as semiconductor start-up losses rose (segment loss Rs50 cr vs Rs9 cr). 12.5% / 13.2% / 13.6% as OSAT volumes ramp.

segments.name: Shanthi Gears (100%)
segments._why: Industrial gears and gearboxes (steel, cement, power, sugar). Revenue fell 14% in FY26 and 15% in Q1FY27 (Rs115 cr). FY27E -5% (weak H1, recovery in H2 on ~Rs100 cr of capex), then +12% a year.

segments.name: EV and new ventures (residual)
segments._why: Consolidated less standalone, CG Power and Shanthi Gears: TI Clean Mobility (EV segment revenue Rs683 cr FY26, Rs239 cr in Q1FY27, +77%), TI Medical (~20% growth guided), 3xper, Kcaltech, Sedis, less eliminations. Residual revenue Rs453 cr in Q1FY27 (+57%). +40% / +35% / +30%.
segments._marginWhy: Residual EBITDA -Rs538 cr FY25, -Rs550 cr FY26 (-41%), about -24% in Q1FY27 (EV segment loss Rs147 cr). Management: past peak quarterly losses, one EV business to break even in FY27 and two more in FY28. -24% / -15% / -8%: losses narrow but do not end in our forecast.

_unallocLabel: Corporate costs not in any block (inside the residual)
_unallocWhy: Eliminations and unallocated items are inside the residual block, defined so that the four blocks sum to reported consolidated revenue and EBITDA.
_capexWhy: Consolidated capex (Screener: FY24 Rs851 cr, FY25 Rs1,213 cr, FY26 Rs1,433 cr). FY27 guidance: TII ~Rs350 cr, Shanthi Gears ~Rs100 cr, group excluding CG Power Rs600-700 cr. CG Power's own capex (switchgear, transformers, CG Semi's OSAT plant) is not guided in our sources (gap): we assume ~Rs1,100 cr in FY27E, falling as the OSAT phase-1 spend ends.
_depWhy: FY26 depreciation Rs664 cr = 7.7% of average gross block; Q1FY27 Rs183 cr (Rs732 cr annualised). 7.2% gives ~Rs745 cr in FY27E.
_treasuryWhy: Other income is entered as a build (below), not as a yield on the consolidated cash, because most of the cash sits in CG Power.
_otherIncomeWhy: Screener other income before exceptional items ('other income normal'): FY25 Rs371 cr, FY26 Rs387 cr, TTM Jun-26 Rs447 cr (Q1FY27 Rs112 cr). Mostly CG Power's treasury income (Rs208 cr FY26, Rs84 cr in Q1FY27 after its QIP) plus TII's non-dividend other income (~Rs69 cr: grants, rent, MF gains) and Shanthi Gears (~Rs15 cr). TII's dividends from CG Power and Shanthi Gears cancel out on consolidation. Rs450 / 480 / 510 cr.
_interestWhy: FY26 Rs79 cr (incl. ~Rs29 cr on leases), Q1FY27 Rs16 cr. Group gross debt Rs754 cr at Mar-26.
_taxWhy: The tax line also carries minorities (engine workaround, as in GODREJIND and UPL): 43.71% of CG Power's and 29.54% of Shanthi Gears' profits belong to other shareholders, and TICMPL's losses carry no tax credit. FY26: tax Rs734 cr + minorities Rs481 cr = 66% of PBT (Rs1,852 cr); FY25 59%. Our parts build (TII 25.2%, CG 26%, Shanthi 25%, residual untaxed) gives 62.5% / 58% / 55% as the untaxed losses shrink relative to profits.

saBuild._why: TII standalone profit before its dividends from CG Power and Shanthi Gears (they are valued at market, so their dividends must not be capitalised again in the P/E part). FY26 standalone: depreciation Rs188 cr (PBDIT 1,295 less PBIT 1,107), other income Rs211 cr of which Rs142 cr dividends from subsidiaries, interest ~Rs8 cr, tax 23.6% (statutory 25.17%). Core PAT FY26 = 821 - 142.27 x (1 - 25.17%) = Rs715 cr. Depreciation rises with ~Rs350 cr a year of capex; non-dividend other income Rs70-80 cr.

_payoutWhy: TII has paid Rs3.50 a share every year since FY21 (~Rs68 cr, ~8-11% of attributable profit).

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Steel costs are fully passed through and engineering volumes keep growing in double digits; CG Power grows ~20% with semiconductor losses fading fast; TICMPL breaks even on schedule and is worth what outside investors paid; the holding-company discount returns to its 2021-26 median.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: Price resets lag again and margins stay near the Q1FY27 level; auto and industrial demand slows; CG Power's semiconductor ramp drags; TICMPL needs the full Rs750 cr programme and its equity is worth nothing; the discount stays as wide as on 30-Sep-2026.

parts.name: TII standalone businesses: P/E on Sep-28E core EPS
parts.metricLabel: Sep-28E core profit (½ FY28E + ½ FY29E, before CG/Shanthi dividends) ₹917 cr × 19x (bull 21x on ₹1,026 cr, bear 15.5x on ₹770 cr)
parts.note: TII's own one-year-forward P/E while the share was the standalone business only (listing to Mar-2020): median 20.8x, cut by the 9.4% auto-component de-rating at 30-Sep-2026.

parts.name: Less: holding-company discount on the listed stakes
parts.metricLabel: Discount × listed stakes ₹78,858 cr (base 34%, bull 0%, bear 65%)
parts.note: Derived from TII's own discount at 21 quarter-ends since Jun-2021 (see Valuation).

parts.name: TI Clean Mobility: TII's investment
parts.metricLabel: Base: TII's cost ₹1,000 cr; bull: Mar-26 fair-value mark ₹1,576 cr; bear: equity worth nothing and the remaining ₹500 cr of the ₹750 cr programme lost (PV ₹473 cr)
parts.note: Outside investors (~₹1,780 cr) hold CCPS that convert only at an IPO; their stake was marked at ₹2,404.70 cr in Mar-2026.

parts.name: Other unlisted subsidiaries at cost
parts.metricLabel: TI Medical ₹265 cr, 3xper ₹310 cr, Kcaltech ₹62 cr, Financière C10 (Sedis) ₹61 cr
parts.note: At TII's cost (AR FY26 note 6a; Q1FY27 deck).

methods.name: Sum of the parts
methods.why: How the street values TII (Motilal Oswal: standalone on P/E, listed subsidiaries at a holding-company discount): ~85% of the look-through value is the market value of CG Power and Shanthi Gears.

methods.name: P/E on consolidated EPS
methods.why: Own one-year-forward P/E on consolidated EPS since Apr-2021: median 62.3x (no trough years), cut by the 9.4% sector de-rating: 56.5x. Rough: consolidated EPS carries CG Power at earnings, not at its ~100x market multiple, and TICMPL's losses at 100%.
